spec_family.name: Exterior Masonry Wall Coating
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish coat painting for exterior masonry wall surfaces (clay brick, CMU, cast concrete, limestone). Covers full prep (cure verification, moisture testing, efflorescence treatment, form-release removal for concrete, power wash, caulk masonry-to-trim joints, surface repair), block filler for CMU (PCA P12 Level 2), alkali-resistant primer (mandatory on ALL new masonry pH 12-14), and finish coats (acrylic or elastomeric coating system). Spray_backroll is the primary application method — spray-only is PROHIBITED on porous masonry (backroll forces coating into pores for continuous DFT). Uses SF as primary UOM. Substrate type (brick/CMU/concrete/limestone) and coating system (acrylic/elastomeric) are key configuration dimensions driving material selection, production rates, and risk assessment. Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in window/door specs.

includes: Cure verification (28-day standard, 7-day with alkali-resistant primer)
Moisture testing (MC < 12% hard stop per ASTM D4263)
Form-release agent removal (cast concrete only — mechanical abrasion or chemical detergent)
Power wash (1,500-2,500 PSI — allowed on masonry unlike fiber cement)
Surface repair (mortar joint repoint, crack fill at QT3/QT4)
Block filler application for CMU substrate (PCA P12 Level 2 Standard Fill)
Full field alkali-resistant primer coat (mandatory on ALL new masonry)
Finish coat application — acrylic (1-2 coats by QT) or elastomeric (2 coats mandatory, QT3+ only)
Interstage inspection, light sand at QT4, and touch-up
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based along house perimeter)
Fixture and utility masking (light fixtures, HVAC units)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, cleaning intensity, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single acrylic finish coat, light wash, acrylic only). QT3=standard (2 finish coats, full wash, acrylic or elastomeric). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, TSP wash, interstage sand, premium materials, raking light inspection). QT5 excluded — not applicable to masonry wall field. All tiers require alkali-resistant primer (pH hazard is not quality-optional).

configuration_dimensions.description: Masonry substrate type. Drives block filler requirement (CMU only), cleaning restrictions (no acid on limestone), production rate modifier, and material coverage rates.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brick is baseline (dense, relatively smooth). CMU requires mandatory block filler (PCA P12). Concrete may need form-release removal. Limestone prohibits acid cleaning and requires breathable coatings. Per-elevation or per-wall section if mixed masonry types on same structure.

configuration_dimensions.description: Coating system for finish coats. Acrylic is standard; elastomeric is for crack-bridging applications.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Acrylic: 10-20 perms breathability, 6-8 mils DFT, 300-350 SF/gal smooth. Elastomeric: 5-15 perms, 20-30 mils DFT, 300-500% elongation, 75-150 SF/gal. Elastomeric requires moisture source assessment and is QT3+ only. Elastomeric is flat-only sheen. Material cost 5-8x higher than acrylic per SF.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray_backroll is gold standard for masonry — spray auto-adds backroll (MANDATORY per Exterior Application Methods Doctrine Part A section 6). Spray-only is PROHIBITED on porous masonry. Roll is fallback for smaller areas or occupied-adjacent. Brush is detail work only. spray_backroll requires 2-person crew.

Satin is most common residential masonry sheen (hides surface irregularities while providing durability). Flat for budget. Semi-gloss not typical for masonry wall field — magnifies surface texture irregularities. Elastomeric coating system is flat-only.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Masonry Wall Field Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable masonry wall field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim elements. Measured per elevation from PaintScope.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item. Covers brick, CMU, cast concrete, and limestone wall surfaces. Substrate_type modifier adjusts effective production rates and material requirements per surface type.

valid_input_states.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY is the single NC state. All new masonry arrives bare — no factory-primed masonry exists. pH 12-14 alkaline surface requiring alkali-resistant primer. Repaint states would require a separate spec.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration. Satin is the most common exterior masonry sheen.

material_systems.name: Block Filler for CMU (PCA P12 Level 2 Standard Fill)
material_systems.notes: Mandatory for CMU substrate. Fills voids to PCA P12 Level 2 standard (max 10 voids per SF). Heavy-body product requiring 527-535 spray tip and 30-mesh filter. Applied BEFORE primer. Not quality-optional — required at all tiers.

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer
material_systems.notes: MANDATORY on ALL new masonry regardless of quality tier. pH 12-14 requires alkali-resistant primer (e.g., SW Loxon Masonry Primer rated to pH 13). Standard acrylic primer NOT suitable. Enables 7-day accelerated coating vs 28-day standard cure.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
material_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior latex. 10-20 perms breathability. 6-8 mils DFT. QT2 single coat, QT3 two coats.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
material_systems.notes: Premium 100% acrylic (SW Emerald, BM Aura). 10-20 perms. Raking light inspection between coats. Two coats standard.

material_systems.name: Elastomeric Coating for Masonry
material_systems.notes: Elastomeric: 20-30 mils DFT, 300-500% elongation, 5-15 perms. Bridges hairline cracks. Two coats mandatory. Not available at QT2. WARNING: high risk of catastrophic delamination if moisture enters from alternate sources. Requires moisture source assessment. Material cost 5-8x higher per SF than acrylic.

modules.notes: Cure verify, moisture test, efflorescence, power wash, form-release, caulk, surface repair
Block filler spray_backroll or roll — CMU only
Protection teardown, equipment cleaning, site cleanup

protection_zones_required.notes: LF-based — measured along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. Roll: drop cloth at base. Spray_backroll: full tarp width over plantings (10-15 ft overspray drift).
Walkways adjacent to masonry wall. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
Patio adjacent to masonry wall. Protection level driven by proximity and application method.
All exterior fixtures on working elevations. Bag or tape over fixture. Use blue tape on fixture (smooth surface) — stucco tape for masking ON masonry.
HVAC condenser units adjacent to masonry wall. Full tarp cover during spray operations. Do not block intake/exhaust if running.

Door casing trim. Same as window casing relationship. Separate spec.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed at elevation (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list in production.json)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Access type is a height modifier, NOT a site condition. Applied per elevation. Scaffold is particularly common for masonry (heavy staging for long-duration work at height).

cross_spec_boundaries.notes: Window/door protection during masonry wall work is NOT this spec's responsibility. Prevents double-counting.
Corner boards, frieze, rake, window/door casing — all separate from masonry wall field.
Soffit underside at masonry-to-eave junction — separate scope.
Below-grade and earth-contact surfaces require different coating systems and prep.
Wind, dew point, surface temperature are scheduling/process concerns per RC-003 pattern. Not estimatable at bid time.

round_configurations.name: Block Filler + Prime + 2 Finish Coats (CMU, QT3/QT4)
round_configurations.notes: Full CMU sequence. Block filler is phase=prep (substrate preparation). 4 applied layers: filler + primer + 2 finish. Elastomeric always requires 2 finish coats.

round_configurations.name: Block Filler + Prime + 1 Finish Coat (CMU, QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy CMU. Single acrylic finish coat on primed CMU. Elastomeric not available at QT2.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats (Brick/Concrete/Limestone, QT3/QT4)
round_configurations.notes: Standard non-CMU. No block filler needed. Elastomeric always requires 2 finish coats.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Brick/Concrete/Limestone, QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy non-CMU. Single acrylic finish coat on primed masonry. Elastomeric not available at QT2.

variants.notes: Economy spray_backroll on non-CMU masonry. Single acrylic finish coat. Full landscape/hardscape protection for overspray.
Economy spray_backroll on CMU. Block filler + primer + single acrylic finish coat.
Standard spray_backroll acrylic on non-CMU. Two finish coats. Full protection.
Standard spray_backroll acrylic on CMU. Block filler + primer + 2 acrylic finish coats.
Elastomeric spray_backroll at QT3. Two elastomeric finish coats mandatory. 1.50x production modifier. Flat sheen only.
Premium spray_backroll acrylic. Interstage sanding. Raking light inspection. Premium materials.
Premium elastomeric spray_backroll. Worst-case modifier stacking scenario. Flat sheen only.
Standard roll-only acrylic on non-CMU. Reduced protection scope — no patio cover needed (no overspray). Slower production, 1-person crew.

key_validations: 31/31 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json
All PS keys use PS_EXT_* namespace — no interior contamination
Block filler CMU-only gating enforced in materials, SOP, and production
Alkali-resistant primer is the ONLY primer system — no standard primer path

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Prep -> Block Fill (CMU only) -> Prime -> Finish 1 -> Interstage (QT3/QT4) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4) -> Final Inspect -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Masonry terminates at openings and trim elements — no cut-in or blending across specs.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection -> Fixture masking -> Equipment setup -> Coating work -> Protection teardown -> Equipment cleanup -> Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Cure verify -> Moisture test -> Prep (efflorescence, wash, form-release, caulk, repair) -> Block filler (CMU) -> Prime (alkali-resistant) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage (QT3/QT4) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4) -> Final inspect -> Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Follow shade for optimal conditions. Scaffold moves per elevation.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray-only on masonry (backroll mandatory). NO oil-based or alkyd products. NO acid cleaning on limestone. NO coating at MC > 12%. NO elastomeric at QT2.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door protection during masonry work is owned by window/door specs, not this spec.
relationships.notes: First exterior masonry spec. Shares protection zone pattern with siding siblings. Key departures: spray_backroll mandatory (opposite of fiber cement), single substrate state, block filler module, alkali-resistant primer only, dual coating system (acrylic/elastomeric), substrate_type configuration dimension.

sections_used: Spray_backroll mandatory on masonry Part A §6

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior masonry wall coating (brick, CMU, cast concrete, limestone). First exterior masonry spec — follows siding exterior pattern with masonry-specific departures. Key features: combined prime+paint (single mobilization), single NC substrate state (SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY), 4 substrate types (brick/CMU/concrete/limestone), 2 coating systems (acrylic/elastomeric), 3 application methods (spray_backroll/roll/brush — spray-only prohibited), 2 sheens (flat/satin), 3 quality tiers (QT2-QT4, QT5 excluded), 31 tasks across 9 modules (incl. block fill module for CMU), 5 material systems (1 specialty + 1 primer + 3 finish), 4 factor modifiers (access/substrate_type/coating_system/QT), 4 round configurations. 8 compatibility rules enforce masonry-specific constraints (oil-based prohibition, alkali-resistant primer mandatory, block filler on CMU, moisture hard stop, spray_backroll coupling, no acid on limestone, elastomeric QT3+ only). QA result: pass (2 minor issues acknowledged).
